pages.text: Two kinds of reward are easy to confuse:$(br)$(li)$(bold)Progression tokens$() advance your tier (see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$(/l)).$(li)$(bold)Spoils$() are loot: relics, boss materials, Simply Swords uniques and gems. They make you stronger and are the pack's best gear, worth hunting bosses for, but they do $(bold)not$() advance tiers and can't be spent as tokens.

pages.title: Relics
pages.text: Relics are exploration and combat trophies, found in structures and dropped by bosses. They level up as you use them and stack into serious endgame power.$(br2)A relic is pure $(italic)spoils$(): it never counts toward a tier threshold. Keep the ones that fit your build; they are a reward layer that runs alongside progression.

pages.title: Play Hybrid
pages.text: All four lanes feed one pool, so you never have to commit to one path. Build a few Create machines, loot a dimension, kill a boss or two: it all banks into the same total.$(br2)The $(bold)pure paths$() exist so a specialist is never blocked from advancing; the $(bold)combined pool$() lets everyone else progress with any mix.$(br2)$(bold)Next: run /icraft codex balance.$()
